authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 2871 karpaṭa gives kapṛā/kapṛo/kāpar cloth and clothing. These simple kapra responses fit that family; the deeper reconstruction remains qualified in Turner’s addendum. Reviewed comparison: Khandesi kāpaḍa “cloth” (f_ov37vn4fvavhu). Possible intra-IA transfer remains open; source forms and provenance are preserved.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 10203 mudrā gives L. mundrī, Nepali mun(d)ro and regional mũdrī ring. These forms fit the ring family, whose remote Iranian origin Turner marks probable. Reviewed comparison: Rana mʊndʌɾi “ring” (f_huituidz7n5pe). Possible intra-IA transfer remains open; source forms and provenance are preserved.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 10990 laśuna gives lasun/lasaṇ garlic in its first branch and rasuna in its second. The simple l-initial forms fit the first branch; larasun has extra rhotic morphology needing review. Reviewed comparison: Dotyali lāśun “garlic” (f_cttd3rqnw6xs6). Possible intra-IA transfer remains open; source forms and provenance are preserved.
